async def check(name,expected,action,kind='CONTROL',literal=None):
 try:
  value=action();observed=await value if hasattr(value,'__await__') else value
 except BaseException as error:observed=dict(harness_error=type(error).__name__,detail=str(error))

class Observer:
 def __init__(self,start=None,finish=None):self.started=[];self.finished=[];self.start=start;self.finish=finish

  self.started.append(a)
  if self.start:raise self.start

  self.finished.append(dict(state=a.state.value,outcome=type(o).__name__,stage=getattr(getattr(o,'stage',None),'value',None)))
  if self.finish:raise self.finish

async def cooperative_and_reentrant():

  c.add(user('external mutation'))

async def actual_help(root,resume):
 # Only an independently verified --help option reaches the real executable.
 # No arbitrary literal/task/model arguments are run by this probe.
 class BoundedExecutor(CommandExecutor):
  async def execute(self,command):
   assert command.arguments[-1]=='--help'
   assert '--' not in command.arguments, 'Refuse a corrected literal prompt: this baseline-only probe must never invoke a model'
   self.command=command
   self.result=await super().execute(command.with_timeout(Duration.seconds(10)))
   return self.result
 ex=BoundedExecutor();agent=CodexAgent(ex,resolve_path(root));outcome=None
 try:await agent.send(user('--help'),conversation=ConversationRef(agent.source,'00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001') if resume else None)
 except CodexOutputError:outcome='CodexOutputError'
 return dict(outcome=outcome,exit_code=ex.result.exit_code,help_instead_of_prompt=b'Usage: codex exec' in ex.result.stdout,option_terminator='--' in ex.command.arguments)
